name: Mama ni wa Naisho no Papa Netori ~Watashi, Oyome-san ni Naru ne♪~
original_name: ママには内緒のパパ寝取り ～私、お嫁さんになるね♪～
source:
I remarried a woman who had a young daughter, Misaki. Despite our concerns, she immediately took to me.

"When I grow up, I will marry my father!" I was so happy to hear that, and even now that she is all grown up, she is still sweet as ever.

One day, my wife went back to her parents' house and I was alone with Misaki that night. I was kissed by Misaki. Words flowed from her lips that were just directly touching mine.

‘Hey, Daddy... do what you want, it’s okay.’
 
[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_223.html#story]official site[/url]]
translation:
我再婚了一个女人，她有一个小女儿，美咲。尽管我们很担心，她还是立即接受了我。

“等我长大了，我就要嫁给我爸爸！”我听了很高兴，即使现在她已经长大了，她仍然像以前一样甜蜜。

有一天，妻子回娘家，那天晚上我和美咲单独在一起。我被美咲吻了。话语从她的嘴唇中流淌出来，直接接触到我的嘴唇。

“嘿，爸爸……做你想做的事，没关系。”
 
[来自[url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_223.html#story]官方网站[/url]]
